label: PF Backlog 45
title: Discovery panel: live LLM questions only (curated set restricted to explicit offline mode)
body: Owner requirement: all agents must produce LIVE LLM-driven questions, not fixed ones. core/discovery_panel.py build_panel() now: retries the agent's model once; the curated perspective set is used ONLY when llm_call is None (explicit offline/test mode); agents whose live generation fails are recorded in panel['skipped_agents'] and get NO curated questions. Config flag live_questions_only (default true) in config/discovery-panel-settings.json. Test: test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_discovery_panel.py::test_live_only_skips_agent_on_llm_failure.

decisions.note: [P4] Live LLM questions only (done; keep enforced).
